newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy 500,000 bbl Dec reformate.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy 500,000 bbl Dec reformate.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has tendered to buy 500,000 barrels of 95-octane reformate for December, traders said on Wednesday.
They said CPC seeks 250,000 barrels of unleaded reformate for delivery in the second half of December and 250,000 barrels of leaded reformate for delivery December 6-10.
Offers for both cargoes are to be on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Keelung or Taichung.
The tender closes on November 5 and is valid for two days.
Earlier this month, CPC cancelled its last requirement for leaded reformate, for December 1-15, delivery due to high international prices and low domestic demand.
In the same tender, CPC bought two 250,000-barrel cargoes of unleaded reformate for November 21-30 and December 1-15 delivery at around $25.90 per barrel on a c-and-f basis.
